Ends the value layers: one output, the expected return.

Adds a one-output layer (orthogonal, gain 1) that estimates the return from a state. The value layers are separate from the policy layers, as in Stable-Baselines3's MlpPolicy.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [RL](../categories/rl.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `ValueHead` |
| Search words | value, critic, head, rl, ppo |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Features** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | The last value layer's output (reached from the Environment's Observation). |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Value** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | The value estimate: connect it to PPO's Value. |

## Settings

The node has no settings.

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Support

| Aspect | Value | Supported | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Workflow Lane | reinforcement learning | Yes | GraphCompiler compiles the RL graph and the Engine's PPO (core/rl) trains it on the environment's copies; PipelineExecutor and the supervised trainer do not run it. |
| Implementation Owner | rl trainer | Yes | As above |
| Support State | real | Yes | As above |

## Usage

```text
Environment -> Dense -> Tanh -> Dense -> Tanh -> Value Head -> PPO
```
